    IsField (ZMod n) ↔ Nat.Prime n

The final proof must compile, preserve the exact statement, and contain no sorry, admit, or added axiom.

{"code":"import Mathlib

theorem fatem_019_zmod_isField_iff_prime (n : ℕ) :
    IsField (ZMod n) ↔ Nat.Prime n := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    classical
    by_cases h0 : n = 0
    · subst h0
      simpa using h
    · by_cases h1 : n = 1
      · subst h1
        simpa using h
      · obtain ⟨p, hp, hpdvd⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd h0 h1
        have hmem : p ∈ n.primeFactors := hp.mem_primeFactors hpdvd h0
        have hnotunit : ¬ IsUnit (p : ZMod n) := ZMod.not_isUnit_of_mem_primeFactors hmem
        have hne : (p : ZMod n) ≠ 0 := by
          intro hz
          have hunit : IsUnit (p : ZMod n) := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hz
          exact hnotunit hunit
        have hunit : IsUnit (p : ZMod n) := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne
        exact (hnotunit hunit).elim
  · intro hn
    letI : Fact (Nat.Prime n) := ⟨hn⟩
    infer_instance
"}

tool_calls.arguments:
{"code":"import Mathlib

theorem fatem_019_zmod_isField_iff_prime (n : ℕ) :
    IsField (ZMod n) ↔ Nat.Prime n := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    classical
    by_cases h0 : n = 0
    · subst h0
      simp at h
    · by_cases h1 : n = 1
      · subst h1
        simp at h
      · obtain ⟨p, hp, hpdvd⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd h1
        have hmem : p ∈ n.primeFactors := hp.mem_primeFactors hpdvd h0
        have hnotunit : ¬ IsUnit (p : ZMod n) := ZMod.not_isUnit_of_mem_primeFactors hmem
        have hne : (p : ZMod n) ≠ 0 := by
          intro hz
          have hunit : IsUnit (p : ZMod n) := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hz
          exact hnotunit hunit
        have hunit : IsUnit (p : ZMod n) := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne
        exact (hnotunit hunit).elim
  · intro hn
    letI : Fact (Nat.Prime n) := ⟨hn⟩
    exact Field.toIsField (ZMod n)
"}
